column1: # Ash Jenna's optional post-Colosso Vale super boss and optional Suhalla Gate fight.

column3:
I remember these roads.
I know which door
your mother waits behind.{page_break}Strange how much
has stayed the same.{end_wait}
Don't go near her.\nLeave Vale alone.{end_wait}
I could walk to that door.\nBut first, let's see\nif you can stop me.{end_wait}
You won. For now.\nI have no reason to\nstay in this village.{end_wait}

They survived the attack.
So I burned the medicine
they had left.{page_break}I wanted them to know
what it feels like
to wait for help.{end_wait}
You did that to them?\nMove. We need to help\nthose men.{end_wait}

I can keep you here.
Every moment we fight
is time they don't have.{page_break}Go on, Isaac.
Let's see how much
your strength is worth.{end_wait}
You won, Isaac.\nGo tend to your soldiers.\nSee what you can save.{end_wait}
I know your plan.\nIt won't work.

Idiots.
Did you think I'd miss
such a cheap trick?{page_break}Lean on tricks and
this is what you get.
